name: Push-up
cues: Brace your trunk; lower chest and hips together.

name: Wide Push-up
cues: Keep elbows angled back; use a pain-free range.

name: Diamond Push-up
cues: Keep elbows close and body in one line.

name: Decline Push-up
cues: Elevate feet; keep ribs tucked.

name: Pike Push-up
cues: Keep hips high and lower head between hands.

name: Bench Dip
cues: Keep shoulders comfortable; avoid dropping below a controlled range.

name: Parallel Bar Dip
cues: Use a stable shoulder position and controlled depth.

name: Ring Dip
cues: Keep rings close and turn them out only as control allows.

name: Inverted Row
cues: Keep body straight and pull chest toward the bar.

name: Ring Row
cues: Keep shoulders down and body rigid.

name: Scapular Pull-up
cues: Keep elbows straight; move shoulder blades down.

name: Dead Hang
cues: Use a secure grip and stop if shoulder discomfort appears.

name: Chin-up
cues: Start from a controlled hang; bring chin over bar.

name: Pull-up
cues: Avoid swinging; finish with chin over bar.

name: Neutral-grip Pull-up
cues: Keep wrists neutral and lower under control.

name: Archer Pull-up
cues: Shift toward one hand while keeping the other arm long.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
cues: Curl pelvis up; minimize swinging.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
cues: Keep the movement controlled and avoid swinging.

name: Lying Leg Raise
cues: Keep lower back gently braced against the floor.

name: Hollow-body Hold
cues: Keep lower back in contact with the floor.

name: Plank
cues: Keep head, hips, and heels aligned.

name: Side Plank
cues: Stack shoulders and hips; keep hips lifted.

name: Reverse Plank
cues: Lift hips without forcing the neck.

name: Floor L-sit
cues: Press tall and keep legs as straight as your mobility allows.

name: Bodyweight Squat
cues: Keep feet planted and knees tracking over toes.

name: Split Squat
cues: Lower under control with a stable front foot.

name: Reverse Lunge
cues: Step back far enough to keep the front heel grounded.

name: Step-up
cues: Use a stable step and control the lowering phase.

name: Single-leg Calf Raise
cues: Use full comfortable range without bouncing.

name: Glute Bridge
cues: Finish by squeezing glutes; avoid arching the lower back.

name: Single-leg Glute Bridge
cues: Keep pelvis level as you extend the hip.

name: Hamstring Walkout
cues: Keep hips lifted while taking small controlled steps.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
cues: Anchor ankles securely and resist the descent.

name: Reverse Nordic Curl
cues: Keep hips extended and lean back within a comfortable range.

name: Half-kneeling Hip-flexor Stretch
cues: Gently tuck pelvis and keep the stretch pain-free.

name: Seated Pike Stretch
cues: Hinge at hips and keep breathing steadily.

name: Quadruped Wrist Rocks
cues: Move gently through a comfortable wrist range.

name: Shoulder Wall Slide
cues: Keep ribs down as arms slide overhead.

name: Burpee
cues: Choose a pace that preserves controlled landings.

name: Mountain Climber
cues: Keep shoulders over hands and hips steady.

name: Bear Crawl
cues: Keep knees low and move opposite hand and foot together.

name: Jump Rope
cues: Use small relaxed jumps and a clear landing surface.

name: Wall-facing Handstand
cues: Use a clear wall and exit safely before fatigue.

name: Handstand Kick-up Practice
cues: Practice controlled entries near a clear wall.

name: Wall Push-up
cues: Keep body straight and hands at chest height.

name: Incline Push-up
cues: Choose a stable incline and keep body aligned.

name: Standard Push-up
cues: Lower chest and hips together with a braced trunk.

name: Decline Push-up
cues: Elevate feet on a stable surface; keep ribs tucked.

name: Bench Dip
cues: Keep shoulders comfortable and use controlled depth.

name: Band-assisted Dip
cues: Use a securely attached band, keep shoulders steady, and log assistance as negative load.

name: Parallel Bar Dip
cues: Use a controlled, comfortable range.

name: Ring Dip
cues: Keep rings close and control their movement.

name: Scapular Pull-up
cues: Keep elbows straight and draw shoulder blades down.

name: Band-assisted Pull-up
cues: Secure the band carefully, avoid bouncing, and log assistance as negative load.

name: Negative Pull-up
cues: Start at the top safely and lower under control.

name: Strict Pull-up
cues: Start from a controlled hang without swinging.

name: Tuck Front Lever
cues: Depress shoulders and keep hips tucked.

name: Advanced Tuck Front Lever
cues: Open the hip angle while maintaining a flat back.

name: Straddle Front Lever
cues: Spread legs and keep shoulders actively depressed.

name: Full Front Lever
cues: Hold a straight line with active shoulders.

name: Tuck Back Lever
cues: Use a safe skin-the-cat entry and keep elbows straight.

name: Advanced Tuck Back Lever
cues: Open hips gradually without losing shoulder position.

name: Straddle Back Lever
cues: Keep elbows locked and body level.

name: Full Back Lever
cues: Maintain a straight body and pain-free shoulder position.

name: Planche Lean
cues: Protract shoulders and lean only as far as wrists tolerate.

name: Tuck Planche
cues: Push tall through shoulders and keep knees tucked.

name: Advanced Tuck Planche
cues: Open the hips while keeping scapulae protracted.

name: Straddle Planche
cues: Keep arms straight and hold a controlled straddle.

name: Pike Handstand Hold
cues: Elevate hips over shoulders and keep elbows straight.

name: Wall-facing Handstand Hold
cues: Keep ribs tucked and use a safe wall exit.

name: Chest-to-wall Handstand Shrug
cues: Elevate shoulders without bending elbows.

name: Freestanding Handstand Hold
cues: Practice near a clear area and exit safely.

name: Pike Push-up
cues: Keep hips high and lower head between hands.

name: Elevated Pike Push-up
cues: Elevate feet on a stable support; control descent.

name: Wall-supported Partial HSPU
cues: Use a padded, controlled range and stable wall support.

name: Wall Handstand Push-up
cues: Maintain a braced line and controlled depth.

name: Jumping Muscle-up Transition
cues: Use a low stable bar and practice a smooth transition.

name: Band-assisted Muscle-up
cues: Use a secure band; keep wrists clear of the bar.

name: Chest-to-bar Pull-up
cues: Pull explosively without kicking.

name: Strict Muscle-up
cues: Use a controlled transition and stable support finish.

name: Tuck Support Hold
cues: Press shoulders down and hold knees tucked.

name: One-leg L-sit
cues: Keep one leg extended and shoulders depressed.

name: L-sit
cues: Lock knees as able and press tall through hands.

name: V-sit
cues: Lift legs higher only while keeping support stable.

name: Assisted Pistol Squat
cues: Hold a stable support lightly and control the descent.

name: Box Pistol Squat
cues: Sit to a stable target and stand without collapsing.

name: Counterbalanced Pistol Squat
cues: Reach arms forward and keep the whole foot grounded.

name: Pistol Squat
cues: Keep the non-working leg clear and descend under control.

name: Band-assisted Nordic Curl
cues: Anchor ankles securely and use a band to scale assistance.

name: Partial Nordic Curl
cues: Anchor ankles and use a repeatable partial range.

name: Nordic Curl Negative
cues: Resist the lowering phase and catch safely with hands.

name: Full Nordic Curl
cues: Lower under control and return with assistance if needed.

name: Glute Bridge
cues: Lift hips while keeping ribs controlled.

name: Elevated Bridge
cues: Use a stable support and keep the range comfortable.

name: Wall Walk to Bridge
cues: Walk hands down only within a controlled range.

name: Floor Bridge Hold
cues: Press evenly through hands and feet; avoid pinching.

name: Vertical Flag Support Hold
cues: Grip a secure pole and keep feet on the ground for support.

name: Tuck Human Flag
cues: Use a secure apparatus and hold a compact tuck.

name: Straddle Human Flag
cues: Keep the pole secure and body controlled.

name: Full Human Flag
cues: Maintain straight legs and stop before grip failure.

name: Tuck Dragon Flag
cues: Hold bench securely and keep shoulders supported.

name: One-leg Dragon Flag
cues: Lower slowly with one leg extended.

name: Dragon Flag Negative
cues: Lower as one unit and stop at a controlled point.

name: Dragon Flag
cues: Keep a rigid line and avoid loading the neck.

name: Weighted Pull-up
cues: Start from a controlled hang and avoid kipping.

name: Weighted Dip
cues: Keep shoulders controlled and use a pain-free depth.
